entities.summary: John Hatch is a former Canadian basketball player. He is a two-time Olympian; is one of the only three-time First-team All-Canadians in Canadian university ("CIAU") basketball history; was one of the most successful players in St. Francis Xavier University's history; played professionally in Switzerland and Belgium for 7 seasons; and has been inducted into several halls of fame.
